title: Dispatch: 19.4.5 magic-item effect source-agreement screen and repairs (attempt 1)
description: Execute eshyra-o9bd.19.4.5's DESIGN (read it fully) and acceptance criteria. Steps: (1) Enumerate the population by query (magic-item records with non-empty mechanics.effects; also effect-like typed payloads they reference). (2) MECHANICAL SCREEN: for every effect, every numeric value and every enumerated vocabulary value (damage type, ability, condition, sense, skill, duration unit) must occur in the item's verbatim description (normalize whitespace, unicode minus/dashes, number words 'one'..'ten' vs digits, 'd' dice notation). Produce the violation list. For each violation decide against the source: real disagreement (repair) or reviewed source-backed exception (e.g. a value derived by printed arithmetic, a table-driven value via tableRef). Keep it as a PERMANENT generalized test only if it is cheap and the exception list is short and individually justified (no blanket allowlist); otherwise keep it as development evidence in notes. (3) SEMANTIC REVIEW batched by effect kind (castSpell, triggeredEffect, advantage, attackAndDamageBonus, immunity, damageResistance, ...): for each effect, compare it with its source sentence for added/dropped/altered quantity, target, condition, duration, trigger, or scope. Record a disposition ledger in bd notes (kind: effects reviewed / disagreements / repaired). (4) REPAIR every disagreement class in the importer (docs/importer-fix-protocol.md: no hand edits; regenerate; explain every generated diff) with ONE generalized invariant per class plus siblings, not one test per example. (5) Registry row magic-item-effects (opus:residual-unverified-effects-semantics): restate as a source-fidelity invariant with a status per the result and no engine-family dependency; engine-pending executionReadiness stays disclosed as unselected backlog. EXCLUSIONS: no deterministic execution, no whole-item clause completeness, condition leaves with non-condition values stay with eshyra-o9bd.19.3.5. HARD STOP: If the failure map reveals a new root cause, requires a new parser or extractor strategy, or creates generated churn outside the direct consequences of the current minimal fix, stop and report instead of broadening the implementation. Host memory: wait until pgrep -fc '^node .*verify-current-worktree' prints 0 or 1; verify:worktree then commit only on success (&&). Close this bead. No push/PR.
notes:
2026-10-10 PROGRESS 1. Population by query (records.json: kind=magic-item with non-empty data.mechanics.effects): 213 items of 240, 472 effects, 56 effect kinds. MECHANICAL SCREEN (every numeric leaf, canonical damage-type/ability/condition/skill/unit vocabulary, spell names, dice and numbers/damage words inside free strings, concentrationRequired=false must occur in the item's verbatim description + name + rarity + the tables the effect references): 5 hits over 472 effects. 2 real (feather-token whip-attack says slashing, source says force; potion-of-clairvoyance concentrationRequired=false with no 'no concentration' in source), 1 reviewed source-backed exception (carpet-of-flying threshold.multiplier=1 means the printed 'normal capacity', 1x the table weight), 2 screen-grammar artifacts (poison/poisoned word form; fixed by stem match). Screen is necessary-not-sufficient: it cannot see dropped/added scope. SEMANTIC REVIEW: all 472 effects of 213 items read beside the source sentence (per-item, all kinds). Additional disagreements found by that review: holy-avenger aura-saves drops 'against spells and other magical effects'; stone-of-good-luck drops 'ability checks'; arrow-catching-shield reaction adds requirement not in source; ring-of-mind-shielding telepathy adds oneWay/requiresLanguage not in source; armor-of-invulnerability resistance excludes 'damage from magical weapons' where source says nonmagical damage.
2026-10-10 PROGRESS 2. Repairs (importer curated specs, pack regenerated via npm run import:dnd5e-srd -- --out packages/core/data/rules-packs/rules__dnd5e-srd-5.1; generated diff is exactly 7 hunks in records.json, no other pack file changed): (1) altered value: Feather Token whip-attack damage slashing->force (source: '1d6 + 5 force damage'); (2) added claim: Potion of Clairvoyance drop concentrationRequired=false (source silent; spell is concentration; siblings with the printed 'no concentration required' keep false); (3) added claim: Arrow-Catching Shield reaction drops invented 'visible to attacker and not behind total cover' requirement; (4) added claim: Ring of Mind Shielding telepathy drops oneWay/requiresLanguage (audience kept; validator boundary still met); (5) dropped scope: Holy Avenger aura saves now carry 'against spells and other magical effects'; (6) dropped scope: Stone of Good Luck appliesTo 'ability checks and saving throws'; (7) altered scope: Armor of Invulnerability carve-out 'damage from magical weapons'->'magical damage' (source: resistance to nonmagical damage). Classes: altered value/vocabulary (1,7), added unsupported claim (2,3,4), dropped scope (5,6). Evidence: magicItemEffectSourceAgreement.test.ts (population-wide mechanical screen with a negative control and one reviewed exception, plus representative scope assertions). Registry row magic-item-effects restated as source-agreement invariant, status narrowed, no engine-family dependency; findingRegistry.test.ts updated accordingly (disclosed-dependency no longer used by a real row). Disposition ledger by kind (all reviewed, read beside source): castSpell 134 (agree, 1 repaired: clairvoyance), triggeredEffect 90 (agree, 1 repaired: whip), advantage 29 (agree, 1 repaired: holy avenger), attackAndDamageBonus 22 agree, immunity 17 agree, damageResistance 16 (1 repaired: armor of invulnerability), rollModifier 7 (1 repaired: luckstone), reaction 3 (1 repaired: arrow-catching), telepathy 1 (repaired: mind ring), all remaining kinds agree. Reviewed non-defects recorded: table-driven values (resistance types, dragon scale mail, prayer beads, giant strength) agree with the printed tables; oathbow half/three-quarters cover = printed 'other than total cover'; rarity-derived +1/+2/+3 match item names; omitted details (e.g. 'at will' on Boots of Levitation) are whole-item completeness, out of scope.
